invites.title: Team invitations
invites.subtitleAdmin: Invite trainers to your organisation and keep track of every invitation.
invites.subtitlePlatform: Invite trainers and admins to your organisation and keep track of every invitation.

form.title: Invite someone
form.description: They get an email with a link that works once and expires after 7 days. Learners are not invited: they register themselves.
form.roleRequired: Choose a role for the invitation.
form.organisationRequired: Choose the organisation for this invitation.
form.conflict: This email address already has an account or an open invitation.

resend.title: Send this invitation again?
resend.body: {{email}} gets a new email. The previous link stops working and the new one is valid for 7 days. Resends used so far: {{used}} of {{max}}.
resend.capReached: This invitation reached the resend limit. Revoke it and send a new invitation instead.

revoke.title: Revoke this invitation?
revoke.body: The link sent to {{email}} stops working immediately. You can invite the same address again afterwards.

errors.conflict: This invitation can no longer be changed because it was already accepted or revoked. The list was refreshed.
errors.notFound: This invitation no longer exists. The list was refreshed.

empty.title: No invitations yet
empty.body: Invitations you send appear here with their status.
empty.filteredBody: Try another status or clear the filter.

users.title: Users
users.subtitleAdmin: Find accounts in your organisation and suspend or reactivate learners and trainers.
users.subtitlePlatform: Find accounts in your organisation, suspend or reactivate them and change roles.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.body: {{name}} is signed out on all devices right away and cannot sign in until you reactivate the account.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.body: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.

roleDialog.title: Change the role of {{name}}
roleDialog.description: {{name}} is currently {{role}}. Choose the new role.
roleDialog.warning: {{name}} will be signed out on all devices and sees the new role after signing in again.

organisationDialog.title: Move {{name}} to another organisation
organisationDialog.description: This signs the user out on every device. Their old sessions will not return if you move them back.
organisationDialog.label: New organisation

errors.conflict: This account changed in the meantime, or the change is not possible. The list was refreshed.
errors.notFound: This account no longer exists or is not available to you. The list was refreshed.

empty.title: No accounts to show
empty.body: Accounts appear here as people register or accept an invitation.
empty.filteredBody: Try a shorter start of the email address or other filters.

organisations.title: Organisations
organisations.subtitle: Create and maintain the organisations that use SAMARTH AI. Deactivating one blocks access and signs out all its users.
organisations.name: Organisation name
organisations.domainsHint: Comma-separated. Leave blank to allow any domain.
organisations.saveError: The organisation could not be saved. Check the name, code, domains, and whether another organisation already uses them.
organisations.deactivated: {{name}} was deactivated and its users were signed out.
organisations.restored: {{name}} was restored. Previous sessions remain signed out.
organisations.deactivateBody: All users in this organisation will be signed out immediately and cannot access the platform until it is restored. Restoring will not restore old sessions.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitleAdmin: Security-relevant events in your organisation, newest first. Each entry is chained to the one before it, so any change to history can be detected.
audit.subtitlePlatform: Security-relevant events across every organisation, newest first. Entries are hash-chained, so any change to history can be detected.

empty.title: No audit entries yet
empty.body: Security events such as sign-ins and role changes will appear here.
empty.filteredBody: Try a different action or time range.

chain.title: Chain integrity
chain.description: Recomputes every hash from the first entry and checks each link.
chain.brokenBody: The check failed at entry {{seq}}: its content or link does not match. Entries from {{seq}} onward cannot be trusted.

demo.title: Simulate tampering
demo.description: Alters one entry in a temporary copy and shows how the check catches it. Stored records are never changed.
demo.detectedBody: Entry {{tampered}} was altered in a copy of the first {{window}} entries. The check broke at entry {{broken}}. Nothing stored was changed.
demo.inconclusiveBody: The stored chain is already broken at entry {{seq}}, so the simulation cannot show a clean comparison.

errors.forbidden: Only a platform admin can do this.
errors.demoOff: The tampering demo is switched off on this server.
errors.notEnough: There are not enough audit entries yet to run the demo.
